jobs.description:
ABOUT STREAM REALTY PARTNERS

Founded in 1996, Stream Realty Partners (Stream) began with a vision. Not one focused on bricks and mortar, but with people at its foundation. Headquartered in Dallas, TX and operating in core markets coast to coast, we complete billions in annual transactions in office, industrial, retail, healthcare, land, and data center properties. With millions of square feet of assignments, Stream is one of the fastest-growing, full-service commercial real estate services organizations in the country. Our team of talented individuals have come together to create our distinct culture, best summarized by our firm’s core values: smart, honest, nice, and passionate. For more information, visit www.streamrealty.com and follow Stream on LinkedIn, Instagram, X and Facebook.

IMMEDIATE IMPACT. MEANINGFUL CAREER.

At Stream, we know our success begins and ends with our people. It is the reason we work hard to attract and retain the best and brightest talent. From day one, you will be an integral member of our high-caliber, collaborative team. We will empower you to apply your energy, expertise, and creativity to meet our client’s needs while instilling you with unsurpassed market knowledge and development opportunities to succeed. When you join Stream, you won’t simply start a new job—you will build a meaningful and impactful career.

Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior GIS Analyst transforms spatial, demographic, labor, and real estate data into insights that help Stream professionals and clients make better location and real estate decisions.

Working across Stream’s national platform, this individual will lead sophisticated site selection, relocation, workforce, and market analyses while developing compelling maps, dashboards, and visual narratives that support business development, client strategy, and decision-making.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics, technology, and storytelling. The successful candidate will combine advanced GIS expertise with strong business judgment and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

The role reports to the Director of Business and Location Intelligence, collaborates closely with local market teams across the country, and is designed as a remote U.S. position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Location Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Lead complex analyses including site selection, relocation studies, labor and workforce analytics, demographic evaluations, and market assessments.
Perform drive-time, distance, trade-area, and origin-destination (OD) analyses to support real estate strategy and client needs.
Develop weighted suitability models, spatial scoring methodologies, and other analytical frameworks to identify and compare optimal locations.
Integrate and analyze data from Esri, Lightcast, commercial real estate platforms, public data sources, and client-provided datasets.
Evaluate data sources, assumptions, and methodologies to ensure analyses are accurate, defensible, reproducible, and appropriate for client use.

Client Strategy & Data Storytelling

Produce high-quality maps, dashboards, StoryMaps, reports, presentations, and other client-ready deliverables.
Translate analytical findings into clear, visually compelling narratives and recommendations that support leasing, investment, development, and location decisions.
Partner with brokers and business teams to determine how spatial insights can strengthen client strategy, pitches, pursuits, and business development.
Ensure deliverables are polished, accurate, consistent with Stream’s brand standards, and tailored to the needs of the audience.

Business Partnership & Advisory

Serve as a location intelligence advisor to brokers, marketing, research, and other business teams by helping define the analytical question, select the appropriate methodology, and interpret results.
Act as a subject matter expert on GIS capabilities, spatial analysis, data sources, and location intelligence methodologies.
Consult with stakeholders to scope projects, identify the right analytical approach, and translate technical findings into business value.
Contribute strategic perspective on how geospatial intelligence can improve client decision-making and differentiate Stream in the marketplace.

Standards, Automation & Innovation

Establish and maintain GIS standards, templates, methodologies, and best practices across the national platform.
Identify opportunities to improve and automate GIS workflows, analytical models, and recurring deliverables using Python, ModelBuilder, and other tools.
Explore and apply AI, automation, and emerging analytical technologies to accelerate research, analysis, and visualization while maintaining appropriate quality controls.
Share knowledge, methodologies, and best practices with GIS and analytical resources across the organization.
Stay current with emerging tools, datasets, and trends in GIS, location intelligence, commercial real estate, and spatial analytics.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Urban Planning, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
5+ years of progressively responsible experience in GIS, location intelligence, geospatial analytics, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading advanced site selection, market, demographic, workforce, or spatial analyses in a fast-paced, client-driven environment.
Experience translating analytical findings into recommendations for business or client audiences.
Portfolio or examples of advanced geospatial analysis and data visualization preferred.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Advanced proficiency in the Esri platform, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Experience Builder, and Dashboards.
Strong experience with site selection, demographic analysis, labor and workforce analytics, and spatial analysis in a client-facing environment.
Demonstrated ability to build and interpret suitability models and other multi-variable spatial analyses.
Expertise in creating client-ready maps, visualizations, dashboards, reports, and presentations.
Ability to work with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and assess data quality, assumptions, and limitations.
Strong communication and consulting skills, with the ability to translate technical analysis into clear business recommendations.
Experience with Python, ModelBuilder, or other GIS automation tools preferred.
Familiarity with commercial real estate, corporate location strategy, economic development, or consulting environments strongly preferred.

Additional Information

Once you have completed your application, you will receive an email from notifications@smartrecruiters.com with a link to the Culture Index survey, which will help us gain a better understanding of your strengths and motivational drives. Please search for the " Senior GIS Analyst
" position in the Culture Index portal. We kindly request that you set aside 10 uninterrupted minutes within 48 hours of submitting your application.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

Is for an Associate
Environmental Scientist
to join WSP's Earth and Environment, Site Investigation & Remediation team
in our Redmond, WA
office. Provides technical assistance and guidance for the collection, identification, and compiling of observational and spatial data concerning a variety of biological, physical, and earth sciences. Provides support and guidance for environmental work and permitting projects. Tasks may include assisting with the development of processes and infrastructure relating to water supply, air emission, pollution control, cultural impact, and preserving the quality of the environment by identifying, controlling, and preventing disruption to environmental systems and species caused by human activity. Generates accurate and concise documentation, assessing and advising on project areas, and applying and integrating the science of the interactions between the physical, chemical, and biological components of the environment to solve environmental challenges. Ensures that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards.

Your Impact

Collect, identify, and compile observational, spatial, and environmental data from samples of air, soil, water, sludge, and other matrices for projects, investigations, and surveys.
Use topographic maps, aerial photographs, GPS units, and other maps and tools to determine exact locations of project areas, site impact, habitat types, and associated physical and wildlife sensitivities.
Assist with preparing environmental survey reports, data entry, impact assessment, and assist with permitting activities for assigned projects (e.g. Endangered Species Act, Clean Water Act permitting, CEQA, NEPA, etc.).
Maintain quality control standards and procedures for accurate and precise measurements, statistical analysis, and reporting.
Perform professional environmental science work and assist with conducting investigations, inspections, and environmental studies and surveys to gain further information on a particular environmental problem or issue, verify site characteristics, and/or to plan for future environmental needs.
Prepare data and visualizations such as tables, charts, accurate reports, and illustrations for the interpretation or presentation of data, findings, or analyses.
Write technical reports summarizing research with findings and conclusions, generating complete, accurate, and concise documentation using electronic systems, field/work site notes, and software.
Comply with safety guidelines and site-specific procedures which include but are not limited to, the maintenance of sample collection, laboratory documentation, written procedures, monitoring systems, and logbooks.
Maintain and calibrate equipment and tools, troubleshooting and reporting on malfunctions, and performing inventory control activities.
Assist in the analysis, evaluation, and interpretation of environmental data obtained during field investigations, offering input with developing action plans for low to mid-level threat mitigation and permitting activities projects to minimize impacts to the health of the environment and the population.
Assist with development and scoping of small- to medium-sized projects.
Work with cross-functional teams in executing project work.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Science, Ecology, Natural Resource Management, or a related life sciences field.
Minimum 1-3 years of post-education related experience working as an environmental scientist and completing environmental surveys, fieldwork, habitat and impact assessments, and/or construction monitoring.
Prior experience with GIS software and Trimble GPS units and ability to use technology for data collection.
Analytical skills, and prior experience with research techniques, local/regional ecology and habitats, and applicable species required.
Knowledge of relevant environmental laws, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
Capable interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to a scientific and non-scientific audience.
Effective self-leadership with attention to detail, results orientation, and managing multiple priorities in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, follow instruction, work independently, and comply with company policies.
Moderate proficiency with business writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, and identify the most effective manner to accomplish objectives of assigned projects.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree is preferred.
40-Hour OSHA Health & Safety Training (HAZWOPER) (29 CFR 1910.120) preferred.

Support and/or lead electric transmission line siting investigation tasks and prepare siting documentation for regulatory review.

Lead coordination with clients and regulatory agencies.

Capable of functioning well within a multi-disciplinary work team.

Travel Required

Occasional standing, walking, bending, or reaching within the office environment. Ability to move between workstations and attend in-person meetings.

Bachelor's degree in a Professional, Architecture, Engineering or closely related field
10 years of experience
Committed to quality, improvement and HDR values
Maintains a professional or engineering registration and has related technical experience
Experienced in development and management of diverse teams
Works cooperatively with other area business class leaders, operations managers, technical directors and marketing managers on business class efforts

Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

Experience with Persistent Systems, Silvus, or similar tactical mesh radios.

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

As an Autonomy Integration Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our Drone Lab near Fort Walton Beach, Florida or at out Ann Arbor, MI office (relocation offered).

What You'll Do

Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.
Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.
Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).
Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification.
System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams.
Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

What We're Looking For

Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred).
Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker).
Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters.
Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or Shell scripting for automation, test suite creation, and processing flight data logs.
Protocols: Direct experience working with serial and vehicle bus protocols (UART, CAN, Ethernet, SPI, I2C).
Leadership: Ability to lead major integration efforts independently and act as the technical link between software, GNC, and hardware teams.

Nice to Have

Active DoD Secret Security Clearance.
Deep experience with the MAVLink protocol and autopilot hardware (PX4, ArduPilot).
Experience with Persistent Systems, Silvus, or similar tactical mesh radios.
FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate and hands-on R/C flight experience.
Background working with defense tech platforms or flight ranges.

Security Requirements

Must be a U.S. Citizen
Must hold or be eligible for a U.S. Secret security clearance

For more information about U.S. security clearances: click here.

Description

Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty in Environmental Health

Rice University invites applications for multiple tenured and tenure-track positions at the senior and junior levels in Environmental Health, with preferred focus areas in environmental and occupational epidemiology, environmental exposures and sustainability, environmental risk assessment, toxicology, infectious diseases, global environmental health, and climate impacts on health, as well as the intersection of these areas with environmental justice. The anticipated start date is July 1, 2027. The ideal candidate(s) would bring an interdisciplinary approach, leveraging quantitative training in biostatistics, epidemiological modeling, spatial analytics (GIS), or AI/data science, with experience analyzing clinical (e.g., electronic medical records), registry (e.g., Texas Cancer Registry), or administrative (e.g., American Community Survey) health data.

Primary academic appointment will be in the Department of Kinesiology, ranked #1 nationally by the popular Niche™ rankings and home to Rice’s Public Health Sciences and Sports Medicine and Exercise Physiology undergraduate degrees. These positions are part of an initiative to support interdisciplinary environmental health scholarship, including a new Climate + Health Excellence Center ( FORECAST ) funded by the Burroughs Wellcome Fund. They will come with robust joint appointments in Departments of BioSciences, Chemistry, and Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences as most appropriate.

The successful candidate(s) will be expected to establish a vibrant, externally funded research program, collaborate across disciplines, and teach at the undergraduate and graduate levels. We especially encourage applications from scientists addressing climate impacts on human health and infectious disease, and contributing to broad themes of sustainability or One Health principles. Potential to connect to exercise science, the department’s other major intellectual theme, will also be explored, such as through interests in impacts of extreme heat, air quality, and toxicants on human physiology and performance.

Candidates must have a PhD, DrPH, or equivalent degree in public health science or a relevant field of natural science or engineering and have completed the requirements for the degree by July 1, 2027.

To apply, please submit the following materials online at https://apply.interfolio.com/193813 : (1) cover letter; (2) curriculum vitae; (3) research statement (3 pages max); (4) statement of teaching philosophy (3 pages max); and (5) contact information for three references. The research statement and statement of teaching philosophy may also include plans for building a diverse and inclusive research group and fostering equitable and inclusive classrooms. Applications that are received by November 16, 2026,
will receive full consideration, but we will continue reviewing applications until positions are filled. For additional information, please visit our department website or contact the search chairs, Dr. Cassandra Diep ( csdiep@rice.edu ) and Dr. Scott P. Egan ( scott.p.egan@rice.edu) .

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

As an Autonomy Integration Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our HQ in Sunnyvale, CA or Ann Arbor, MI office (relocation offered).

What You'll Do

Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.
Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.
Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).

Responsible for periodic, after-hours on-call response to environmental incidents, as needed.

Coordinates with supply chain personnel to procure contractor and consultant services, as needed.

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, environmental science, environmental studies, hydrology, hydrogeology, mine engineering, ecology or related field - required
Five (5) years direct experience managing environmental compliance programs and projects, with a minimum of three (3) years in an industrial setting - required
Strong computer skills including experience with PowerPoint, Word and Excel - required
Excellent verbal, written, presentation and interpersonal skills - required
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously - required
Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with others - required
Ability to identify and implement opportunities for improvement - required

Ability to drive results and ensure completion of time sensitive deadlines – required
Ability and willingness to work outdoors throughout the year in all weather conditions - required

What We Can Offer You

A comprehensive compensation package including bonuses benefits, and stock purchase plans where applicable
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
An Opportunity to transform Traditional Mining into the future of Digital Mining
Opportunities to grow and learn with the industry colleagues are endless
Access to a variety of career opportunities across locations
Nevada Gold Mines is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer

Thank you for your application, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Our mission is to be the world’s most valued gold and copper mining business. We are committed to partnering with our host countries and communities to transform their natural resources into tangible benefits and mutual prosperity.

With one of the largest portfolios of world-class and life-long gold and copper assets in the industry - including six of the world's Tier One gold mines - Barrick's operations an projects span 18 countries and five continents.
